name: Minecraft Tower Defence
summary: A Minecraft-themed maze building tower defense variation, where you make the path yourself and place towers and traps along to fight back hordes of aggressive mobs before they get to your base. All in-game mechanics and behaviors are based on actual Minecraft game tropes (such as the "towers"/turrets being dispensers filled with items like arrows or eggs, something that can actually be done in Minecraft). It features 3 different arenas: Island (based on the plains biome), Dungeon (based on the stronghold structure) and Nether (based on the Nether dimension).
